product_scope: itpay is the public CLI entry point for Buyer services and existing itpay sell Seller workflows.
title: Install And Identify The ItPay Agent Runtime
purpose: Install in one host-permitted persistent npm location, prepare the real Agent once, and enable the same-package Skill.
when_to_use: The CLI is being installed or upgraded.
The agent needs to confirm its stable runtime identity and default output Host.

commands.intent: identify actual supported Agent Type if needed
commands.success_signal: select actual agent_type without asking the human

commands.intent: prepare device and report authoritative account state
commands.success_signal: setup_ready with device_status ready and account_status authenticated or login_required; not proof Skill is enabled

commands.intent: read and enable complete same-package Skill
commands.success_signal: read original Skill and persist it using the host official skill mechanism; retain actual path/version

agent_rules: Use standard npm with one host-permitted persistent tool location or global prefix. Fix the exact entry, actual Agent Type and Backend; do not change HOME/npm configuration or an existing project dependency. Do not use floating npx.

Run setup once after installation or upgrade, then read and enable the current package Skill before business. Same-version already-read/enabled Skill needs no repeat. No automatic login or business to prove setup.

Preserve actual npm error and nonzero exit. ENOTEMPTY is an old package/retirement directory conflict, not proof host policy forbids writes; broker wrappers do not establish the underlying cause. Stop repeated installation; only precisely authorized old-package cleanup, never identity deletion. setup_ready requires authoritative device/account checks; unknown/404/incompatibility is not ready.
The current public setup link selects the channel and matching contract: latest/app for production, next/dev for beta. Do not let an old bundle or memory override this choice.
Production defaults to https://app.itpay.ai. Testing may set ITPAY_BACKEND_URL to the exact official URL the configured official test Backend only when explicitly requested; follow the CLI allowlist.

If Backend compatibility cannot be verified, stop this round. minimum_cli_version is a protocol floor, not a verified matching artifact. Ask the maintainer for the matching distribution; do not guess a version or downgrade.
Only install a replacement when its exact artifact and Backend contract have been verified; then reread that package Skill. Never change Agent Type or Device identity to recover compatibility.
Use one exact type: codex-desktop, codex-cli, claude-code-desktop, claude-code-cli, workbuddy, zcode, doubao-work, kimi-code, or openclaw.

For compatibility, a global --agent-type codex declaration is normalized immediately to codex-desktop; all registration, output, and returned commands use codex-desktop. Never generate the alias, and do not use codex as an install target.
One local private key is reused, while Device registrations and quota lineage remain separate for app.itpay.ai, sandbox.itpay.ai and dev.itpay.ai.
Within each official Backend registration, each Agent Type has one Agent Instance; all windows and chats of the same type reuse it.
Agent Type identifies the runtime. Host and target only select a presentation destination; load render-hosts only when a handoff cannot be shown.
Keep the exact Agent Type in every next or recovery command; do not fall back to a type previously used by another runtime.
Do not change Agent Type or rotate local identity to reset quota or recover a failed command.
Skillhub and local host bundles are separate installed artifacts; verify their version and packaged Skill/docs instead of assuming an npm update changed them.
forbidden: Do not use terminal, claude-code, or plain-chat as Agent Types. Do not generate codex as an Agent Type; it is accepted only as a legacy global declaration and becomes codex-desktop before any request.

Do not set or suggest a Backend outside the CLI allowlist: https://app.itpay.ai, https://sandbox.itpay.ai, https://dev.itpay.ai; local loopback requires the CLI development flag. Do not switch Backend to evade a failure.
Do not claim that install writes host configuration or registers a device; it only prints instructions.
Do not create a new identity for a different window, task, chat, or process of the same Agent Type.
